verdict.rationale: Notion's own pages promise in-product AI answers grounded in workspace data with citations, plus always-on agents. The Agent API docs confirm Notion Agents and Custom Agents exist and can chat over sessions. The evidence is mostly marketing taglines, though, and nothing describes proactive insights or suggestions drawn from database data. Missing for 10: detailed docs on AI-generated insights and suggestions from user data, evidence of proactive recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
